overview: Debuting in Street Fighter III and returning from V, Alex is once again a grappler specializing in burst movement and relentless pressure. Where Manon's gameplan is about mixups and Zangief's is about landing the SPD, Alex instead is a high-aggression, high mobility brawler who specializes at getting into medium-close range and forcing your opponent into constant guesses.

Alex's buttons are long reaching and strong, giving him good pokes that allow him to roll into his game plan. St. MK has incredible range for harassing enemies, st. HK is excellent as a big punish and trap tool, and st. HP has an utterly gargantuan disjointed hitbox to win poke wars. Both of the standing heavies can be charged too, which gives him better frame data and—in HP's case—the ability to special cancel, which he is without otherwise. Cr. MP and st. MP are his go-to cancelable pokes, and his st. LK can be linked after certain moves for longer combo extensions.

Condition them to block with Flash Axe, his brand new light and medium variant of the powerful Flash Chop. Axe is safer on block and easier to combo into, as the powerful Chop only cancels properly on charged st. HP or cr. HP. Knee Smash returns as his anti-air special; The light and medium versions are extremely fast and both give good oki, while the heavy is your ideal combo tool. Power Bomb and Hyper Bomb are Alex's high-damage command throws, and it even retains the Street Fighter III 'back turn' mechanic, where moves that cause your opponent to spin before the throw (such as Heavy Lariat or Flash Chop) pay out better screen positioning and damage.

Brand new to Alex's kit is Prowler Stance, which functions similar to Chun Li's Serenity Stream. It can be input raw to low profile Alex, or done out of combos to fire the vast arsenal of new and returning moves from it. From Prowler, his options are limitless—the all new Palm Thrust is a quick jab that's cancelable into basically anything, Air Stampede and Slash Elbow are as terrific approach tools, Sweep Combination is a low target combo that gives you good oki and big damage on counterhit, Shoulder Launcher can catch and punish any jump or air move including Psycho Crusher or Honda Headbutt, and Heavy Lariat now comes with armor to catch your opponent attempting a Drive Impact or fireball. And when Alex has them conditioned to only block or Parry, sneak in a quick Hyper Takedown or Dangerous Armbar to punish their hesitance. Taking one knockdown from Alex can be incredibly stressful just from the sheer arsenal of moves and approach angles he has at his disposal.

Mr. America's incredible oki roulette comes at a steep cost; His defensive tools without spending Super are subpar, forcing him to rely on carefully timed jumps and buttons when he's pressed against the turnbuckle. He lacks many cancellable normals, especially from lows, limiting his ability to both get inside and punish walking out of his pressure. His command throws are strong but need back turn to get big damage, something a pure grappler like like Zangief doesn't have. Prowler Stance is a phenomenal tool, but it has specific and limited ways to cancel into, and though he can move in it, he's limited to dashes and he cannot block. He also lacks a simple throw loop, forcing him to spend drive (or Prowler into Takedown) to keep the opponent scared. And like all grapplers, he struggles with zoners and fireballs -- moreso than even Zangief, as his charged heavies do not have armor.
All in all, if you like big damage, relentless offense, or you just really like looking at his muscles, Alex has a 141 and 2/3% chance of being your character.

pick.title: STRETCH 'EM
pick.text: Hard knockdowns and looping pressure in and out of Prowler Stance, letting Alex maintain a terrifying offense.

pick.title: Good Workrate
pick.text: A wide array of tools from command grabs to evasive hops to armored strikes, with even more reward on Punish Counter.

pick.title: 20-Inch Pythons
pick.text: Long-reaching pokes with great reward even at a distance.

pick.title: OUTTA NOWHERE!!!
pick.text: Able to pressure with plus frame attacks like heavy lariat & command grabs to keep opponents guessing from anywhere on the screen

avoid.title: In-Ring Psychology
avoid.text: Recognizing when to use your options from Prowler Stance for maximum reward.

avoid.title: Getting Cut Off
avoid.text: Poor reversal options barring a raw Super Art.

avoid.title: Abnormal Throw Loop
avoid.text: Has to use Drive Rush or enter Prowler Stance in order to throw loop properly, telegraphing Alex's intentions more than other characters.

avoid.title: Just Playing the Heel
avoid.text: No cancelable lows, limiting his back walk punishes.

moves.name: Sledgecross Hammer
moves.notes: Causes a cinematic on grounded opponents and a wallsplat on airborne opponents (can juggle in the corner); wallsplat is a free juggle state if SA2 starts the combo (otherwise, maintains the existing juggle state); can choose which version to cancel into from OD Flash Chop (1st hit stays grounded, 2nd hit launches); effective fireball counter due to range and invincibility; cinematic version gives decent Drive Rush oki (but DR~Throw can only beat reversal 4f normals on wide characters like Alex, Marisa, Sagat, Blanka, E. Honda, and Zangief)

moves.name: Raging Spear
moves.notes: Alex's best reversal option; sends opponent far away (oki only possible near the corner); puts opponent into a limited juggle state that can lead to trade combos depending on distance and the opponent's attack hitstun (e.g. fireball trade, early anti-air timing)

moves.name: The Final Prison
moves.notes: Cinematic time regenerates ~2 Drive bars for Alex; significantly less range than Alex's other Supers; poor oki after the cinematic (e.g. spaced DR~5MP or DR~2MK); has 2 different cinematics depending on whether it KOs the opponent

moves.name: The Final Prison (CA)
moves.notes: Available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.1 Drive bars for Alex; significantly less range than Alex's other Supers; better oki than standard SA3 (e.g. DR~Throw or DR~5HP into tick MP Power Bomb); has 2 different cinematics depending on whether it KOs the opponent

moves.name: Flash Chop
moves.notes: Puts opponent into Backturned state and Forces Stand on hit; slow startup but plus on block (leaves the opponent inside OD Power Bomb range for a tick throw); true blockstring from 5[HP] dealing significant Drive damage; has both a strike hitbox as well as a separate 1-hit projectile clash box on frames 25-29 (starting 1f before active); this allows Alex to hit the opponent even when clashing with higher-priority projectiles like Supers (though it doesn't dissipate any hits of the higher priority projectiles); recovery is cancelable on hit into Power Drop (63214P) or Collapsing Driver (4MK) on frame 40 (opponent must be grounded for these to connect); can omit the follow-up cancel and link normals afterward (lights on regular hit, 5MP on counter-hit, 2HP on Punish Counter)

moves.name: Flash Axe
moves.notes: Safe on block if spaced from a light string and maintains pressure up close on hit; has both a strike hitbox and a separate 1-hit projectile clash box during the active frames; this allows Alex to hit the opponent even when clashing with higher-priority projectiles like Supers (though it doesn't dissipate any hits of the higher priority projectiles)

moves.name: Flash Axe
moves.notes: Can transition into Prowler Stance on hit; important combo tool that is relatively safe if spaced out; extends a large vertical combo-only hitbox for juggle consistency; has both a strike hitbox and a separate 1-hit projectile clash box during the active frames; this allows Alex to hit the opponent even when clashing with higher-priority projectiles like Supers (though it doesn't dissipate any hits of the higher priority projectiles); can get midscreen oki with Drive Rush into a delayed button or throw; Prowler Stance cancel: KD +46 oH (variable on airborne opponents)

moves.name: Flash Chop
moves.notes: 2 hits; 1st hit keeps opponent grounded (SA2 cancel allows cinematic hit); 2nd hit puts opponents into a limited juggle state (SA2 cancel causes wall splat); can transition into Prowler Stance on hit; completely safe on block due to pushback; has both a strike hitbox as well as a separate 2-hit OD projectile clash box on frames 14-19 (starting 1f before active); this allows Alex to hit the opponent even when clashing with higher-priority projectiles like Supers (though it doesn't dissipate any hits of the higher priority projectiles); leads to good midscreen oki with Drive Rush or a 6-frame safe jump with j.HK (can often outspace 5f reversals as well); Prowler Stance cancel: KD +37 oH (variable on airborne opponents)

moves.name: Roundhouse Kick
moves.notes: Long range sweep; has juggle potential

moves.name: Crouching Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Forces stand; head and arm hurtbox are anti-air invuln on frames 10-14; decent anti-air but weaker against close jumps; active frames 1-2 can hit grounded or airborne and are cancelable; active frames 3-6 can only hit airborne opponents and cannot cancel; cannot hit cross-up; Punish Counter puts opponents into a limited juggle state (much higher launch vs. airborne); stand-sized hurtboxes on frames 10-30 (considered crouching); very short horizontal range (usually requires Drive Rush to combo properly); useful combo tool into Prowler Stance (combos naturally into Palm Jab) or into HP Flash Chop when used out of Drive Rush; Prowler Stance cancel: +7 oH / +4 oB

moves.name: Crouching Light Kick
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; TC into 2HK requires Drive Rush/Counter-hit/Punish Counter (useful 5f punish at longer ranges, especially with Modern controls)

moves.name: Twisted Drop
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage from 2LK starter; does not combo naturally (requires Drive Rush / Counter-hit / Punish Counter); allows 2LK to be a useful punish option at ranges where 2LP whiffs (and especially in Modern where Alex cannot punish with 2LP); cancelable into Prowler Stance on hit only for oki; 6f blockstring gap between the hits (interruptible on block without DR~2LK or Burnout); Prowler Stance cancel: KD +17 oH

moves.name: Crouching Light Punch
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-7 is vulnerable only to aerial attacks (preventing its use as an anti-air) and is projectile invincible to avoid High Tiger Shot; DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame

moves.name: Illegal Knees
moves.notes: Leaves Alex at neutral advantage after forward dash for a pseudo-throw loop; Drive Rush allows real corner throw loops but gives weak midscreen oki; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Crouching Medium Kick
moves.notes: Good low starter from Drive Rush (links to 2MP except from longer ranges); solid poke range to punish back walk

moves.name: Crouching Medium Punch
moves.notes: 4f extra recovery on whiff; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-9 is vulnerable only to aerial attacks (preventing its use as an anti-air) and is projectile invincible to avoid High Tiger Shot; Special/DR/DI cancel is delayed until after active frames; relatively poor DR Cancel options (no natural combo into 2HP > 236HP, max range cannot cancel to 4MK > 2HP, and only a true blockstring into 5LP/2LP/2LK)

moves.name: Prowler Stance
moves.notes: Cannot block while in stance (counter-hit state for entire duration); Alex is in a crouching state on frame 5 onward (stand-sized hurtbox until frame 8); crouch-sized hurtbox on frames 9-15; Low Profile on frame 16~ (but does not duck under standard projectiles); can transition into one of several different follow-ups on frame 18 onward (frame 17 for Stance Exit); can be canceled with any up input (2PP~8); Alex remains in stance until canceled or hit; Alex switches facing direction when opponent switches sides

moves.name: Dangerous Armbar (Spiral DDT)
moves.notes: Turns into Spiral DDT on Punish Counter (different animation with separate KD advantage and higher damage/meter properties); can only hit standing opponents; regular version gets strong meterless corner oki or Drive Rush midscreen oki; Punish Counter version can walk for meterless oki anywhere on screen; immediately loses low profile state and exits stance upon activation but retains crouching state on frames 1-14 (standing-sized hurtboxes on frames 9-14); can be canceled into from Palm Jab for a more effective tick throw

moves.name: Low Retreat
moves.notes: Distance: 1.00; cannot cancel into follow-ups during the dash animation (except Stance Exit 1f before recovery ends); maintains Low Profile / crouch for entire duration and remains in Prowler Stance afterward; holding back does not buffer the dash (must be timed using the standard input buffer window)

moves.name: Low Rush
moves.notes: Distance: 1.76; cancelable into Slash Elbow (6P) on frames 1-14 (if done later, Elbow is buffered at the usual follow-up timing); can perform Tactical Hop (LK) / Air Stampede (MK) on frame 18~; can perform Stance Exit on frame 28 (final recovery frame); cancelable into other Stance follow-ups on frame 21~; maintains Low Profile / crouch for entire duration and remains in Prowler Stance afterward; holding forward does not buffer the dash (must be timed using the standard input buffer window)

moves.name: Slashing Elbow
moves.notes: Button strength determines distance and startup (LP shortest/fastest, HP longest/slowest); exits Stance after use; high active frame count allows it to be spaced or used with meaty timing for better advantage; Counter-hit/Punish Counter puts opponent into a limited juggle state; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; head and arm hurtbox are anti-air invuln on frames 8-15 (LP) / 11-18 (MP) / 14-21 (HP); maintains Low Profile on startup until 5f before active; maintains crouch state until the end of active frames (standing-sized hurtboxes after the Low Profile frames end); expands significantly on the 3rd active frame making it easier to space for advantage on block; causes a screen shake effect when blocked with frame advantage (3rd/4th active frames)

moves.name: Exit Prowler Stance
moves.notes: Can start exiting stance 1 frame earlier than other follow-ups; fastest total stance + exit time is 42f; Low Profile and crouch state on frames 1-9 of exit animation; Alex remains in a counter-hit state for entire exit duration; holding up direction will buffer the Stance Exit at the earliest possible timing

moves.name: Sweep Combination 1 (Flying Suplex)
moves.notes: Hitconfirmable (but unsafe) long range sweep; Counter-hit/Punish Counter transitions into Flying Suplex for extra damage, meter, and a Hard Knockdown (no difference between 1st or 2nd hit of the TC when this happens); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (allows TC follow-up to combo); Alex remains in stance after recovery except on Perfect Parry or when Flying Suplex connects; maintains Low Profile and crouch state for entire duration; 3f blockstring gap between hits (will frame trap if opponent attempts a punish too early); can be canceled into from Palm Jab (consistent combo ender at any range)

moves.name: Sweep Combination 2 (Flying Suplex)
moves.notes: Counter-hit/Punish Counter transitions into Flying Suplex for extra damage, meter, and a Hard Knockdown (no difference between 1st or 2nd hit of the TC when this happens); Alex remains in stance after recovery except on Perfect Parry or when Flying Suplex connects; maintains Low Profile and crouch state for entire duration; 3f blockstring gap between hits (will frame trap if opponent attempts a punish too early); leaves Alex +1 after manual Stance Exit for corner oki; can whiff when the first sweep connects at max range

moves.name: Heavy Lariat
moves.notes: Can be held to gain damage, 2f extra blockstun, and armor properties; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; Counter-hit (+8) / Punish Counter (+10) puts grounded opponents into a Backturned state that can link to 4MK or MP/OD Power Drop (can whiff at long range); shorter range vs. crouching opponents; great pressure tool for depleting the opponent's Drive gauge; can be canceled into from Palm Jab (up to 3 jabs vs. standing or 2 jabs vs. crouching); uncharged version comes out if button is held up to 12 frames; can be spaced out to hit on later active frames for better advantage (up to +8/+5); holding the button 1-5f results in 12f startup; holding the button 6-12f increases the total startup incrementally (up to a maximum startup of 20f); maintains Low Profile on frames 1-6 and crouch state on frames 1-14 (standing-sized hurtbox on frames 11-14)

moves.name: Heavy Lariat (Hold)
moves.notes: More damage and blockstun than uncharged version; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; Counter-hit (+8) / Punish Counter (+10) puts grounded opponents into a Backturned state that can link to 4MK or MP/OD Power Drop (can whiff at long range); armor absorbs 2 hits as long as the button continues to be held (armor ends 5f before the attack hits); shorter range vs. crouching opponents; great pressure tool for depleting the opponent's Drive gauge; can be canceled into from Palm Jab but only combos on Punish Counter; can be spaced out to hit on later active frames for better advantage (up to +8/+7); button must be held 13f (early release ends the armor and results in uncharged version); maintains Low Profile on frames 1-16 and crouch state on frames 1-23 (standing-sized hurtbox on frames 20-23)

moves.name: Tactical Hop
moves.notes: Distance: 1.157; much shorter trajectory and lower height than a standard jump; can perform air normals or Flying Cross Chop on frames 22-32 (buffers from frame 8~, then buffers a grounded normal if pressed on frame 33~); immediately loses low profile state and exits stance upon activation; prejump frames 1-2 are in a crouching state followed by a standing state on frames 3-6; Lower Body Projectile Invuln on frames 6-8 (helps jump over projectiles on startup); has a smaller body hurtbox on frames 6-33; 3f landing recovery like a regular jump but cannot block when landing from an empty jump; Alex is in a Counter-hit state for entire move duration; can be canceled into from Palm Jab

moves.name: Palm Jab
moves.notes: Fast and long range jab that maintains the stance's Low Profile and crouching state; cancelable into other Prowler Stance moves (except Stance Exit, Forward/Back Dash, Hyper Takedown, or Slashing Elbow) and into standard specials / DI / DR; Alex remains in stance if not canceled (forced to exit after Perfect Parry); chained jabs form a true blockstring (can chain 4 jabs on hit or 3 on block); frame advantage compares the end of the jab recovery to the opponent's hitstun/blockstun but is only really relevant for tick throws with Hyper Takedown or when using Slashing Elbow afterward; can only tick throw into Hyper Takedown (Stance LP+LK) after 1 jab

moves.name: Hyper Takedown (Death Valley Bomb)
moves.notes: Acts like a normal throw with extra range (can be teched); turns into Death Valley Bomb on Punish Counter (different animation with separate KD advantage and higher damage/meter properties); leads to good oki anywhere on screen; immediately loses low profile state and exits stance upon activation but retains crouching state on frames 1-7 with standing-sized hurtboxes; cannot be canceled into from Palm Jab (only in throw range after 1 jab on hit or block); a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Air Stampede
moves.notes: Can be steered left/right; cannot hit cross-up; Alex is considered grounded on the 2nd active frame (anti-air invuln specials will lose if they don't hit before this frame); Punish Counter puts opponents into a limited juggle OTG bounce state (Hard Knockdown if no move is juggled afterward); immediately loses low profile state and exits stance upon activation (remains crouching on frames 1-8 with a standing-sized hurtbox on frames 5-8); very short hitstop gives little time for opponent to make a decision on block (significantly longer hitstop on Punish Counter for easier juggle confirms); stomp is block reactable but difficult to anti-air (can hold back to cause many anti-airs to whiff at some ranges); can intentionally whiff over the opponent to bait parry (opponent can option select with 4~4MPMK to option select a parry + Drive Rush, though the timing is strict to punish Alex); can be canceled into from Palm Jab

moves.name: Shoulder Launcher (Falling Moon)
moves.notes: Counter-hit/Punish Counter transitions into Falling Moon for higher damage, Hard Knockdown, and improved meter properties (regardless of whether 1st or 2nd hit connects); () refers to Falling Moon damage; not airborne despite the animation; puts opponents into a limited juggle state on normal hit; maintains Low Profile on frames 1-7 and considered crouching on frames 1-13; cannot hit cross-up but will autocorrect if input while dashing under the opponent (allows for side swap juggle routes); can be canceled into from Palm Jab

moves.name: Guillotine Hammer
moves.notes: Side switch; no real strike/throw oki in the corner but can pressure with Drive Rush normals; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Oblique Stomp
moves.notes: Transitions into Collapsing Driver for a cinematic knockdown on backturned opponents; good punish starter into 2MP; strong pressure tool with a 5LP frame trap that links to 5MP on Counter-hit, or with DR~4MK into itself

moves.name: Collapsing Driver
moves.notes: Performs a cinematic knockdown on backturned opponents; can be canceled into after 236HP on hit; counts as 2 separate moves for damage scaling; can whiff after max range 236HP on crouching opponents; deals less damage than Power Drop but maintains same side and gives better HKD oki

moves.name: Back Taunt
moves.notes: "Let's do this!"

moves.name: Back Taunt (Omega Wing Buster)
moves.notes: "Aaalex. Aaaalex! AAAALEX!!! AAHHHH!!"

moves.name: Standing Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Disjointed poke with great range; grounded Punish Counter crumple puts opponent into a free juggle crumple state and is +23 before opponent falls to the ground (no grounded combo possible); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (free juggle on Punish Counter); extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; can be held for a stronger, longer-range version (uncharged version comes out if button is held up to 15 frames); holding the button 1-8f results in 16f startup; holding the button 9-15f increases the total startup incrementally by 1f (up to a maximum startup of 23f)

moves.name: Standing Heavy Kick (Hold)
moves.notes: Button must be held 16f (early release results in uncharged version); more damage, range, and juggle potential than uncharged version; stops forward momentum when used out of Drive Rush (good for baiting DR checks); Punish Counter (ground/air) puts opponent into a free juggle state; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state on normal hit; startup frames 17-24 extend a small leg hurtbox (more easily counter-poked by standing buttons); extends a wide leg hurtbox on the first 10 recovery frames; Prowler Stance cancel: KD +42 oH / +4 oB (KD advantage varies on airborne opponents)

moves.name: Standing Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Disjointed poke with great range to harass the opponent's Drive gauge; cancelable into Super for a hitconfirm or to punish Drive Impact; extends a wide arm and foot hurtbox on the first 12 recovery frames; high active frame count for meaty setups (up to +8 oH / +1 oB, but high pushback on block); can be held for a stronger, fully cancelable version (uncharged version comes out if button is held up to 15 frames); holding the button 1-7f results in 12f startup; holding the button 8-15f increases the total startup incrementally by 1f (up to a maximum startup of 20f)

moves.name: Standing Heavy Punch (Hold)
moves.notes: Button must be held 16f (early release results in uncharged version); more damage and range than uncharged version; has juggle potential unlike uncharged version (useful in some routes like juggled SA2 when not fully cornered); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; stops forward momentum when used out of Drive Rush (good for baiting DR checks, but will usually be out of range for link follow-ups afterward); enables true blockstring into HP Flash Chop for huge Drive damage and plus frames; true blockstring when canceled into Drive Impact (can be delayed to manually create a gap); extends a front leg hurtbox on frames 8-19 of startup (more easily counterpoked by lows); extends a wide arm and foot hurtbox on the first 15 recovery frames; can be safe to Drive Impact if absorbed late; Prowler Stance cancel: +9 oH / +6 oB

moves.name: Standing Light Kick
moves.notes: Very long range for a 6-frame button (but slow for a light normal); DR cancel is delayed until after active frames

moves.name: Standing Light Punch
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; Alex's only 4f attack with above average range

moves.name: Standing Medium Kick
moves.notes: Foot hurtbox shifts backward on frames 5-16f (more effective at counter-hitting low pokes); long range poke with good hitbox priority and no extended hurtbox before active frames; creates a useful spacing trap against Ryu/Akuma/Terry 2MK and Ed 2MP using 5LP~2LP~2LP or 2LK~5LP~2LP that grants a Punish Counter link to 5LK; extends a wide leg hurtbox on the first 11 recovery frames

moves.name: Standing Medium Punch
moves.notes: 2f extra recovery on whiff; extends a wide arm and foot hurtbox on the first 15 recovery frames; can lead to a hitconfirmable TC knockdown; great meaty tool with very low pushback (up to +6 oH / +3 oB)

moves.name: Palm Strikes
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage starting from 5MP (full sequence on hit does the same damage as just a counter-hit on the HP itself); easily hitconfirmable but fairly low risk and DI-safe between hits; cancelable into Prowler Stance on hit only for oki; 1f blockstring gap between hits (up to 3f if delayed, can throw off Perfect Parry timing); can be useful to stay close in Burnout (no blockstring gap but becomes +1 on block with some pushback); on block, leaves Alex in throw range if done from point blank; Prowler Stance cancel: KD +24 oH

moves.name: Neutral Taunt
moves.notes: "Mind if... I loosen up... a bit?"

moves.name: Neutral Taunt (Omega Wing Buster)
moves.notes: "... BOOM!"

moves.name: Aerial Knee Smash
moves.notes: Active frames 1-2 can hit grounded or airborne; active frames 3-8 can only hit airborne; Drive/Super meter gain only applies to the first hit when blocked; cannot hit cross-up; slow for anti-air purposes but the range can be used to punish landing recovery of divekicks or similar moves; useful as a combo ender even from max range light normals; allows strong meterless oki in the corner or Drive Rush oki midscreen

moves.name: Aerial Knee Smash
moves.notes: Active frames 1-2 can hit grounded or airborne; active frames 3-8 can only hit airborne; Super meter gain only applies to the first hit when blocked; cannot hit cross-up; Hard Knockdown allows strong meterless oki anywhere on screen; combos and anti-airs in all the same situations as HK version (and even more lenient in juggles due to the faster startup)

moves.name: Aerial Knee Smash
moves.notes: Anti-air grab (cannot hit grounded opponents); cannot hit cross-up; best overall anti-air at closer ranges due to its fast speed and upward trajectory; allows strong meterless oki in the corner or Drive Rush oki midscreen

moves.name: Aerial Knee Smash
moves.notes: Anti-air grab (cannot hit grounded opponents); cannot hit cross-up; more horizontal range and an extended combo-only hitbox make it useful in juggles; allows strong meterless oki in the corner or Drive Rush oki midscreen

moves.name: Power Bomb
moves.notes: Shortest range / fastest startup version; turns into Power Drop on backturned opponent; most useful for tick throws when the range allows it; Alex's strongest meterless Drive Reversal punish (but can whiff when blocked at max range)

moves.name: Power Bomb
moves.notes: Longest range / slowest startup version; useful in some oki situations (e.g. corner throw + dash) but less useful in tick throw scenarios; turns into Power Drop on backturned opponent

moves.name: Power Bomb
moves.notes: Medium range / startup version; turns into Power Drop on backturned opponent; can be used in some tick throw situations especially out of Drive Rush normals

moves.name: Power Bomb
moves.notes: Startup of HP version with range in between LP/MP versions; most useful overall in tick throw scenarios; turns into Power Drop on backturned opponent; more consistent and slightly more damaging as a Drive Reversal punish than HP version

moves.name: OD Hyper Bomb
moves.notes: Does not switch sides; sets up a safe jump or Drive Rush oki anywhere on the screen; cannot be canceled into Omega Wing Buster; () refers to Punish Counter damage, scaled damage refers to version canceled from 236HP combo starter; maintains the same damage scaling as the preceding OD Power Drop (does not count as a separate move for scaling); backturn connect can occur even without 236HP starter (e.g. after opponent jumps over Alex)

moves.name: Power Drop
moves.notes: Switches sides and leads to Drive Rush oki even midscreen; cancelable into Omega Wing Buster by inputting PP (cannot hold buttons for the entire animation, input during the 2nd body slam); () refers to Punish Counter damage, scaled damage refers to version canceled from 236HP combo starter; the version that comes out after 236HP has more range than any standard version of Power Bomb (but can whiff at absolute max range vs. crouching opponents); the starter scaling affects Omega Wing Buster damage when punishing with a raw OD Power Drop, while the combo scaling affects it when canceled from HP Flash Chop; backturn connect can occur even without 236HP starter (e.g. after opponent jumps over Alex)

moves.name: Power Drop
moves.notes: Switches sides with no real oki; no difference between strengths once the grab connects; the version that comes out after 236HP has more range than any standard version of Power Bomb (but can whiff at absolute max range vs. crouching opponents); () refers to Punish Counter damage, scaled damage refers to version canceled from 236HP combo starter; backturn connect can occur even without 236HP starter (e.g. after opponent jumps over Alex)

moves.name: Headbutt (Block)
moves.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; 4f less hitstop on block compared to most Drive Reversals (changes the punish timing); see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Headbutt (Recovery)
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); 4f less hitstop on block compared to most Drive Reversals (changes the punish timing); see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Chop
moves.notes: Good range and damage for an overhead; when used out of Drive Rush, combos into 5MP at any range

moves.name: Forward Taunt
moves.notes: "You know what I'm gonna do to you once I'm warmed up? THIS!"

moves.name: Forward Taunt (Omega Wing Buster)
moves.notes: "Bring it."

moves.name: Lariat Kick
moves.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: Flying Cross Chop
moves.notes: Forward Jump only; 15f extra recovery on whiff; Alex is in a crouching state during landing recovery (standing-sized hurtbox for the first 3 frames); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; leg hurtbox is projectile invuln on frame 19 until landing

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Decent all-around jump-in for horizontal approaches; lower body projectile invuln 10-21f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Best downward hitbox priority for vertical approaches; spike knockdown on airborne opponents; lower body projectile invuln 9-24f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Light Kick
moves.notes: Cross-up; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead on tall characters

moves.name: Jumping Light Punch
moves.notes: Quick air-to-air

moves.name: Jumping Medium Kick
moves.notes: Most horizontal range of Alex's jump-ins but more difficult to time than j.HK; requires frame perfect timing to connect on a standard crouching hurtbox (4f timing vs. tall crouching opponents); lower body projectile invuln 8-25f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Medium Punch
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; lower body projectile invuln 7-21f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Arm Lock
moves.notes: No true throw loop without Drive Rush (can dash + LP Power Bomb, dash up into spaced normals, or use Drive Rush for better strike/throw oki); DR~5HK leaves Alex +7/+2 anywhere on screen and in range for a tick command grab (HP in corner, OD midscreen); midscreen, can also hold the DR~5[HK] to throw off Perfect Parry timing or punish delay tech; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Drive Parry
moves.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: Drive Rush Cancel
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: Parry Drive Rush
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.393 (min/throw), 1.722 (min/block), 3.530 (max/final DR frame)

moves.name: Omega Wing Buster
moves.notes: Can only be performed after OD Power Drop on a backturned opponent; 2800 damage refers to base damage without scaling (1680 is the most it can theoretically do at 60% scaling); fully invincible for the entire cinematic; pushes opponent a full screen away (no possible oki); PP input must be pressed rather than held for the entire throw cinematic (timing is around the 2nd body slam)
